curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain that impaired driving is illegal and deadly, which substances count, why drugs are as dangerous as alcohol, mixing drugs with alcohol, prescribed drugs and never using drugs to hide fatigue.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per impairment rule, with a contrast card for legal drugs alone versus mixed with alcohol.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming a substance and asking whether driving after using it is legal.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover alcohol as a depressant and alcohol concentration, then how it affects judgment, vision, reaction time and coordination.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for alcohol concentration, judgment, vision and reaction effects.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on how alcohol affects driving skills.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain standard drink sizes, why drinks vary, proof, how fast alcohol concentration rises and falls, how the body removes alcohol, and why people react differently.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per drink and concentration fact, with a contrast card for waiting versus so-called sobering tricks.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on standard drinks and lowering alcohol concentration.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the drink-or-drive rule, planning while sober, alternatives to impaired driving and the legal drinking age.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for the safest policy, planning ahead, alternatives and the drinking age.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on planning to avoid impaired driving.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain the DWI alcohol limits, implied consent and when an officer may ask for a test, refusal consequences, and the roadside preliminary breath test versus the evidentiary test.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per limit and testing rule, with contrast cards for the three limits and the two kinds of test.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on DWI limits and implied consent testing.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover criminal and administrative penalties, reinstatement, aggravating factors, the temporary license, first, second, third and fourth offenses, work permits and felony DWI.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per penalty rule, with a contrast card comparing revocation minimums by offense.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming an offense level and asking the minimum revocation.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain how ignition interlock works and when it is used, the zero tolerance rule for drivers under twenty-one, and the commercial license penalties.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per interlock, young driver and commercial rule, with a contrast card for the interlock limit versus the legal limits.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on ignition interlock and limits for young and commercial drivers.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover cannabis and hemp impairment, using them in a vehicle, storing opened packages, owner responsibility, open alcohol containers and controlled substances in vehicles.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per cannabis and container rule, with a contrast card for the trunk versus the glove compartment.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on where opened cannabis and alcohol may be carried.
